name: Flip Deck Scroll
description: A sticky 100vh viewport with a long scroll runway that scrubs a 3D card deck through rotateX (four gradient-media faces pre-rotated and backface-gated), over a giant drifting uppercase serif ticker stripe.
interactions: the section is a sticky 100vh over a 4098px runway; scroll position drives progress across six 250px windows starting at 649/900/1799/2050/2949/3200px
the deck rotateX = 90 * (summed window progress), scrubbed with a scroll lerp of 0.12; faces (pre-rotated k*180) are shown only while within +-180deg of edge-on
the serif ticker stripe translates -120px per window and each row drifts continuously (wpmn-td-drift 36s linear infinite)
card media scales 1.05 to 1 on hover; the corner arrow swaps along the diagonal on hover (450ms)
dual drive: a scroll listener plus requestAnimationFrame keep it working where rAF is suspended; window.__sectionUpdate re-syncs
under 809px the deck flattens to a stacked list (no 3D, no runway); prefers-reduced-motion stops the ticker drift and media transition
